name: Cortico
tagline: Bringing underheard voices to the center of stronger civic spaces through recorded small-group dialogue and AI-assisted sensemaking.

news_articles.title: How AI Can Help Cities Listen to Their Citizens
Cortico's Deb Roy on Amplifying Underheard Voices

academic_citations.title: AI-Assisted Civic Engagement: Sensemaking from Small-Group Dialogue

policy_outcomes.description: Partnered with NYC City Planning to gather community voices on Cross Bronx Expressway planning process.
Used by City of Cambridge MA to gather community input for City Manager hiring process.
City of Durham used Cortico to amplify underheard voices in community engagement.

outcome_methodology: Qualitative sensemaking; audio highlights and transcripts; human-led pattern identification supported by AI
documented_limitations: Small-group dialogue model may not scale to large populations
AI bias in pattern recognition from transcripts requires human oversight
Limited longitudinal data on policy impact
curation_criteria: Community partners selected based on commitment to inclusive engagement and alignment with participatory democracy principles
contributor_governance: Staff-led; community partners are collaborators but not governors
government_partnerships: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
ai_involvement: Central — AI-assisted sensemaking of small-group dialogue transcripts; CEO Deb Roy is former Twitter CTO and MIT Media Lab professor
